newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Novel Denim gains.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Novel Denim gains.

text.p: Shares of Novel Denim Holdings Ltd racked up solid gains at their market debut on Thursday, rising four points to 22 with over 3.8 million shares exchanging hands by the last hour of trading.

The number of shares on offer had been raised to 4.25 million from the 3.75 million indicated in the original filing. In a further show of strength, the deal, lead managed by Morgan Stanley Dean Witter, was priced at $18 a share, above the estimated $15 to $17 per share range. The Hong Kong-based company provides denim cloth and apparel manufacturer supplies.
Trailer Bridge Inc shares rose 1-1/2 over their IPO price of $10. The gains came on the back of a cut in the price range to $10 to $11 a share from $11 to $13 a share.
About 2.7 million shares were sold with Alex Brown as lead underwriter. Trailer Bridge is an integrated trucking and marine freight carrier.

Chemical marketer and distributor JLM Industries Inc also made its debut on Thursday in a 2.3 million share deal led by Oppenheimer. Shares were flat at their IPO price of $10. The original price talk of $12 to $14 had previously been pared back to $10 to $12 a share.
